sloka: मेघ स्तनित निर्घोषान् दुर्धर्षान् समरे परैः ।सहस्रम् वाहिनीः तत्र जाम्बूनद परिष्कृताः ॥५-६-३४॥
transliteration: megha stanita nirghoṣān durdharṣān samare paraiḥ ।sahasram vāhinīḥ tatra jāmbūnada pariṣkṛtāḥ ॥5-6-34॥

translations.english: He saw in the palace of Ravana, the demon king, thousands of troops adorned with gold, fully protected with armour of gold shining like the morning Sun.
